summary: Tower site in Apache County, AZ, listed gone on the Firelookout.org Arizona list; no other source found for its history.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.org's Arizona list marks it gone; no source describes the site today

evidence.supports: Kinney Butte listed in Apache County as a tower, status gone

notes_for_editor: Story is about 35 words, well below the 120-word floor, because the only evidence is one list row. Not padded. Two searches and the Forest Lookouts Arizona index found no other mention of Kinney Butte; westlookouts.weebly.com/kinney-butte.html returned 404. The Apache-Sitgreaves search returned nothing for this site. Coordinates come only from the list. The list page is the same one used for the other two towers.
